observations: Native readiness: root EC2 completed (lineage-root-terminal-1) precedes first EBS list success (lineage-root-ready-list-readiness-4) by 42.281054 seconds between sampled request starts. Child completed/readiness gap is 52.749184 seconds; sibling gap is 10.285127 seconds. These are sampled gaps, not exact transition durations.

Native pagination: child ListSnapshotBlocks pages are [100,3], covering indices 0..100,1000,2047. Forward, reverse and sibling ListChangedBlocks pages are [100,2], covering indices 0..100,1000. Identical parent payload b rewritten at child index 1000 is still returned as changed; both changed-block tokens read the same verified b bytes.

Native empty pages: self-comparison pages are [0,0]. Page 1 has metadata and NextToken; terminal page 2 has ChangedBlocks:[] and raw null BlockSize, ExpiryTime, LastEvaluatedBlockIndex, NextToken and VolumeSize, yielding only ChangedBlocks:[] in boto3. All changed-page raw responses include LastEvaluatedBlockIndex:null. Absent-side block tokens are raw null and omitted by boto3.

Native token scope: a valid snapshot page token overrides StartingBlockIndex=2047 and returns 100,1000,2047; a valid changed-page token returns 100,1000. Snapshot token on another snapshot, changed token on another pair, cross-operation page tokens and block-token-as-page-token return ValidationException HTTP 400 Reason INVALID_PAGE_TOKEN. Parent block token on child and page-token-as-block-token return ValidationException HTTP 400 Reason INVALID_BLOCK_TOKEN. Exact supplied tokens and native messages remain in calls.

Native retention: EC2 confirms the parent missing before child listing and reads. Child indices remain unchanged; explicit-zero index 0, rewritten index 1000 and inherited index 2047 match their recipes. The earlier child token for inherited index 2047 remains usable. Sibling comparison indices remain unchanged after parent deletion.

Native deleted-parent read: lineage-get-deleted-parent-old-token returns HTTP 200, DataLength=524288 and checksum Qib0wLZSCPxxAsnoZ1mqGTwYYUfxBvjcHbuEUOOwNdw=. Its request starts 2.972107 seconds after the EC2 missing-check request starts. The body checksum and length were verified in memory; this exploratory call did not perform direct recipe equality, so its captured expected_payload/expected_bytes_match remain null. Post-capture digest/length comparison matches original parent payload a. No later direct-plane deletion visibility or invalidation was measured.

Native bad-count terminal: one written block with ChangedBlocksCount=2 returns HTTP 202 Status=pending, is initially EC2 pending, and is first later sampled in error after 677.1096644988284 client seconds (lineage-bad-count-state-677). StateMessage is Changed blocks count mismatch for snapshot; Progress is 0%. This is an observation upper bound, not an exact failure latency.

Native Timeout=10 terminal: no-write snapshot remains pending at lineage-timeout-state-909 and is error at lineage-timeout-state-929, sampled 928.7673706095666 client seconds after StartSnapshot returned. StateMessage is Snapshot timed out; Progress is 0%. This does not establish a transition exactly at 600 seconds.

Native post-error admission for both terminal cases: ListSnapshotBlocks, PutSnapshotBlock and StartSnapshot using the error snapshot as parent return ResourceNotFoundException HTTP 404 Reason SNAPSHOT_NOT_FOUND. CompleteSnapshot returns HTTP 202 Status=error, including the corrected bad-count request. EC2 error state and message remain unchanged.

Post-capture verification: 214 native calls; 19 binary responses with matching native checksums; 18 direct recipe equality checks and one additional deleted-parent recipe digest/length match. Recipes reproduce stored SHA256 digests. Complete child traversal and before/after deletion index equality match fixture inputs. All five created snapshots were deleted and individually confirmed EC2 InvalidSnapshot.NotFound.

documented.contract: FirstBlockToken is absent if the first snapshot has no changed block at that index.
Deleting a snapshot removes data referenced exclusively by it; data referenced by other snapshots is preserved.
Changed-block pagination can include empty pages while scanning allocated candidate blocks; continue using NextToken until no token remains.
Timeout is in minutes, minimum 10; snapshot is cancelled after no writes or inactivity following the last write.
Both snapshot IDs are required. MaxResults is 100..10000; NextToken overrides StartingBlockIndex.
ChangedBlocksCount is the number of written blocks; completion seals against further writes.
